title: Improving Cropping Practice Monitoring with Spatial Technologies
reason: Discusses the increasing need for spatialized information in agricultural practices and future research directions.

tasks.task: Describe the current approach and limitations in agricultural remote sensing studies.

subtasks.text: Explain the increasing need for spatialized information in agricultural practices due to agronomic, environmental, and economic reasons.
Note that most existing studies are exploratory in nature, heavily relying on local knowledge and using just one type of sensor.

tasks.task: Outline proposed future research directions to improve the monitoring of cropping practices.

subtasks.text: Mention the need for using land stratification in future research.
Pay attention to the recommendation for combining data from multiple sensors.
Highlight the suggestion to use expert knowledge-driven methods for improved monitoring.
Focus on the use of new spatial technologies like the sentinel constellation for monitoring cropping practices.
